patch.value: Options considered: delete topoSort and rely on Set iteration order; retain the iterative parent-before-child traversal; replace it with recursive traversal. Retain the iterative traversal. Reachability yields the source tip before its ancestors, and a multi-commit rebase proves replay must reverse that discovery order. Push-time deduplication also makes diamonds linear and recursion would risk stack exhaustion on machine-generated history.
Retain explicit topological ordering for rewrite ranges
Decide whether topoSort is redundant or a required safety property after coverage showed its parent-queue arm had not previously executed.

Decision names the ordering invariant, alternatives, evidence, and consequence; a multi-commit rebase test fails if newest-first discovery order is replayed directly; full coverage reaches 100/100/100
